UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT 'clos', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), closure_type, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR)||' '||store_name, region||'/'||format, CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(is_current AS VARCHAR)||' '||CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR)||' '||CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store WHERE open_date IS NOT NULL OR close_date IS NOT NULL OR store_id>=900 OR store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, st.store_id, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND st.store_id<900)
SELECT 'rows' k, count(*) a, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) b, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) c, sum(net_amount) d, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) e FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'test', count(*), count(DISTINCT store_id), 0, sum(net_amount), 0 FROM s WHERE category='ZZ Test' OR store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt', count(*), count(DISTINCT store_id), count(DISTINCT business_date), sum(net_sales_before_returns), sum(returns_net) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'rptdup', count(*), count(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)), 0,0,0 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH net_lines AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ns, sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_ns, sum(returns_net) ret FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id, r.store_id) store_id, m.ns mine, r.ns rpt, m.ns-r.ns diff, r.ret
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.store_id=m.store_id
ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(r.ns,0)) DESC, 1
LIMIT 12

WITH net_lines AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
sales AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines
          WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
trading AS (
 SELECT cs.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days
 FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN dim_date d
 WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900
   AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.is_trading_day
   AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date<=d.calendar_date)
   AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date>=d.calendar_date)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name, t.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(s.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM sales s JOIN trading t USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
